measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two M3 mounting holes: diameter of each, distance between their centres, and their position relative to the board centre (and relative to the side where the input wires leave)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: total thickness of the board including LEDs, and how far the input connector/wires stick out from the back face and where it sits
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: length and width of the board, the diameter of its four corner holes, and the distance between hole centres along each side
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: overall height of everything above the top face of the perfboard (ESP32 on headers, screw terminals, capacitor), and the length of any solder pins sticking out below the board
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board

measures.what: which end of the perfboard the USB-C port is at, how far the port mouth is from that board edge, how far its centre is from the board's long-side centreline, and the port mouth width and height
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: plug housing width, height and length (the part that goes toward the port), and the plug's overall dimensions
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: Looking down at the ESP32 side with the USB-C ports at the bottom edge: distance from the perfboard's bottom short edge to the ESP32's bottom edge (does the ESP32 end stick out past the board, or sit inside it? say by how much), and distance from the perfboard's left long edge to the centre of the USB-C port you use for power, and the distance from the ESP32's left edge to that port centre
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: thickness of the bare board, and how far the soldered pin tips or wires stick out from the underside (max)
measures.reply: perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: width and height of the metal port opening (mouth), and the width and thickness of the plastic of the charger's USB-C plug where it enters the port
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: screws you will hang it on
measures.what: head diameter, head thickness, shank diameter, and how far you'll leave the screw sticking out of the wall; also the horizontal spacing you want between the two screws if you have a preference
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.
